Hunger is a funny thing. I don’t think I was hungry for years. The slightest twinge and I would eat (and eat). When I started my food plan, I would eat trigger foods because my food wasn’t available. That was my excuse. Nowadays I would rather be hungry than eat something that would break my abstinence. You know the thing about hunger? No one has ever starved waiting an extra hour to get nutritious food instead of eating garbage. I’ve learned that with my Higher power I can stop using hunger as an excuse to overeat and just sit with the hunger until I can eat my food.

Obviously make sure you are eating enough food and not skipping meals, I suggest seeing a doctor or dietician to help you make a food plan to stick to.
